How to order

Four simple steps

  1. 01

    Pick your design

    Open Explore, choose Hoodies and pick your design, 001 to 004.

  2. 02

    Add your details

    Name, contact, batch and size. Add custom text for ₹60 if you want it printed.

  3. 03

    Pay and upload

    Scan the QR, pay the exact amount and upload your payment screenshot.

  4. 04

    Get your receipt

    Save your order ID. Your order is recorded and we will take it from there.

Good to know: All hoodies are delivered together in one bulk delivery to your batch. Please collect yours from there. Thank you for your understanding!
